message: Invoice #8821 shows a charge of $1,240 but our contract rate is $980/month. Can someone look into this?

classification.rationale: The message references an invoice charge discrepancy and asks for someone to look into it.

enrichment.core_issue: Customer wants a review of an invoice discrepancy where they were charged more than the contract rate.

summary: The customer reports that invoice #8821 shows a charge of $1,240 instead of the contract rate of $980. This medium‑urgency billing discrepancy could affect their financial records. The Billing team should review the invoice details and correct any overcharge.
